summary: Trillion Energy International filed a Form 6-K reporting a non-brokered private placement update and warrant extension. The company closed 17,172,419 units at CAD $0.15 per unit for gross proceeds of CAD $1,501,900 and debt settlement of CAD $1,073,963. Each unit consists of one common share and one-half warrant exercisable at CAD $0.25 for one year. The offering is being upsized to CAD $3,500,000. Proceeds fund work program obligations on the M47 Concession. This is a capital-raising event, not a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring.
